drivers: Mixed refinery outages and Gulf storm shut-ins
Heavy oil glut in Americas due to freight squeeze
Petcoke rally narrowing discount to coal
outlooks.summary: Supply disruptions (Ras Tanura strikes, Gulf shut-ins, US refinery outages) are offset by a heavy oil glut in the Americas and possible switching to coal. Price is down 16% over 3 months, and the headline score is near zero.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch how fast US Gulf output returns and whether Middle East strikes on refineries continue.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应扰动(拉斯塔努拉遇袭、墨西哥湾减产、美国炼厂停工)被美洲重油过剩及可能转向燃煤所抵消。价格3个月下跌16%,新闻供应压力得分接近零。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停工与墨西哥湾风暴减产交织
运费紧张导致美洲重油过剩
石油焦上涨缩小与煤炭的价差
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾产量恢复速度,以及中东对炼厂的袭击是否持续。

drivers: Fed rate hike fears and strong dollar
Gold at 14-month low, ETF outflows
Investors shifting to cash and bonds
outlooks.summary: There are no supply headlines. News is about falling prices driven by macro factors, not shortage. A supply-driven upside price risk is not indicated.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the next Fed policy signal and US dollar and yield moves.
outlooks.summary_zh: 没有供应方面的新闻。消息面主要是宏观因素导致价格下跌,而非短缺,因此不存在供应驱动的上行风险。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息担忧与美元走强
金价触及14个月低点,ETF资金流出
投资者转向现金和债券
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美联储下一次政策信号以及美元和收益率走势。

drivers: DRC reimposes four-month export ban from Nov 30
Glencore output halved under Congo quotas
Price already down 24% in 3 months
outlooks.summary: The DRC, the top producer, is halting cobalt exports again from November 30. Price has fallen 24% in 3 months, so the ban is not yet priced in and points to a rebound in the next 1-3 months.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the Nov 30 ban start, any exemptions, and Chinese refiners' inventory levels.
outlooks.summary_zh: 主要生产国刚果(金)将自11月30日起再次暂停钴出口。价格3个月已下跌24%,禁令尚未完全反映,未来1-3个月有反弹风险。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)自11月30日起重新实施为期四个月的出口禁令
配额限制使嘉能可钴产量减半
价格3个月已下跌24%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注11月30日禁令生效、是否有豁免,以及中国精炼厂的库存水平。

drivers: Thailand chemical export ban (indirect)
Chile copper output near 23-year low
Price up 18% in 3 months
outlooks.summary: Headlines are mostly indirect: general mining and policy news with little molybdenum-specific disruption. Price is already up sharply, so the shortage looks partly priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for Chilean copper by-product output and any China or Peru supply news.
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻多为间接相关的矿业和政策消息,缺少针对钼的具体供应中断。价格已大幅上涨,短缺因素似乎部分已被price in。
drivers_zh: 泰国化学品出口禁令(间接影响)
智利铜产量接近23年低点
价格3个月上涨18%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注智利铜副产品产量以及中国或秘鲁的供应消息。

drivers: Zimbabwe lithium tax and 2027 export ban plans
Thailand chemical export ban (indirect)
Price down 13% in 3 months
outlooks.summary: Zimbabwe's policy tightening adds modest supply risk, but the ban is for 2027 and miners seek a delay. Other headlines are indirect, so the upside is mild.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether Zimbabwe confirms or delays its 2027 export ban.
outlooks.summary_zh: 津巴布韦政策收紧带来一定供应风险,但禁令针对2027年且矿商要求推迟。其他新闻为间接影响,上行幅度有限。
drivers_zh: 津巴布韦锂税及2027年出口禁令计划
泰国化学品出口禁令(间接影响)
价格3个月下跌13%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注津巴布韦是否确认或推迟2027年出口禁令。

drivers: China expands export controls, adds 14 entities
Thailand bans mining chemical exports to Myanmar
Laos mine suspended after dam breach
outlooks.summary: Tighter Chinese export controls, Thailand's chemical ban affecting Myanmar mining, and a Laos suspension all point to tighter supply. Prices are up 36% over 12 months, but the news suggests further upside.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Myanmar and Laos output and any new Chinese export licence rules.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国收紧出口管制、泰国禁止向缅甸出口采矿化学品以及老挝停产,均指向供应趋紧。价格12个月上涨36%,但消息面显示仍有上行空间。
drivers_zh: 中国扩大出口管制并新增14家实体至不可靠实体清单
泰国禁止向缅甸出口采矿化学品
老挝矿山溃坝后暂停作业
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注缅甸和老挝产量以及中国新的出口许可规定。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts squeeze supply
Thailand chemical export ban affecting Myanmar mining
Price up 56% in 12 months
outlooks.summary: Congo conflict and Indonesian cuts are tightening supply, and Myanmar-linked pollution measures add risk. Price is already up strongly over 12 months, but flat over 3 months, so more upside is possible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Indonesian export volumes and Myanmar (Wa) mine output.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产使供应趋紧,与缅甸相关的污染管控措施增加风险。价格12个月涨幅较大但近3个月持平,仍有上行可能。
drivers_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产挤压供应
泰国化学品出口禁令影响缅甸采矿
价格12个月上涨56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注印尼出口量以及缅甸(佤邦)矿山产量。

drivers: Major Chinese antimony mine halts production
China's US export ban suspension nears expiry
Price down 56% in 12 months
outlooks.summary: A major Chinese mine halt and the looming expiry of China's export-ban suspension to the US are bullish. Price is down 56% over 12 months, so there is room to rebound.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether China extends its US export ban suspension and when the mine restarts.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国一座大型锑矿停产,且中国对美出口禁令暂停期即将到期,均利多。价格12个月下跌56%,存在反弹空间。
drivers_zh: 中国大型锑矿停产
中国对美出口禁令暂停期临近到期
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国是否延长对美出口禁令暂停期以及该矿何时复产。

drivers: Chinese export controls continue to bite
Governments racing to fund ex-China supply
Price up 67% in 3 months
outlooks.summary: Export controls keep supply tight and new non-China capacity will take time. Price has already jumped 67% in 3 months, so some shortage is priced in, but pressure remains.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Chinese export licence decisions and any ex-China project start-ups.
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口管制使供应持续紧张,中国以外的新产能需要时间。价格3个月已暴涨67%,部分短缺已被price in,但压力仍在。
drivers_zh: 中国出口管制持续生效
各国政府加紧资助中国以外的供应
价格3个月上涨67%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口许可决定以及中国以外项目的投产情况。

drivers: Mixed refinery outages and Gulf storm shut-ins
Heavy oil glut in Americas
Petcoke rally encouraging coal switching
outlooks.summary: Supply disruptions are offset by a heavy oil glut and possible switching to coal, and the headline score is near zero. Price is up 15% already, so the signal for further upside is weak.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US Gulf refinery run recovery and GPC feedstock availability.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应扰动被重油过剩及可能转向燃煤所抵消,新闻得分接近零。价格已上涨15%,进一步上行的信号较弱。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停工与墨西哥湾风暴减产交织
美洲重油过剩
石油焦上涨促使转向燃煤
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾炼厂开工率恢复情况以及生焦原料供应。

drivers: Mixed refinery outages and Gulf storm shut-ins
Heavy oil glut in Americas
Petcoke-to-coal discount narrowing
outlooks.summary: Outages are balanced by an Americas heavy oil glut and coal-switching risk. Price is up 46% over 12 months but down 5% over 3 months, so there is no clear shortage signal.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US Gulf production recovery and the petcoke-to-coal price gap.
outlooks.summary_zh: 停工因素被美洲重油过剩和转向燃煤的风险所抵消。价格12个月上涨46%但3个月下跌5%,没有明确的短缺信号。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停工与墨西哥湾风暴减产交织
美洲重油过剩
石油焦与煤炭价差收窄
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾产量恢复情况以及石油焦与煤炭的价差。
